proposal.goal: Advance Jichi Insight Phase 15 to the next canonical municipality candidate, Akita City (052019), after the successful Morioka ADE pilot. Read docs/ADE_AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_GOAL.md, data/catalog/phase15_core_capital_review_queue.json, data/indexed/akita-city/source_inventory.json, the Phase 15 candidate schema, and completed reviewed packages as read-only context. Do not modify the canonical Phase 15 queue or any reviewed/public data. Create a complete non-public Akita review candidate at data/candidates/akita-city/review_candidate.json and deterministic Akita candidate regression coverage under tests/. Because these files do not yet exist, the planner MUST declare each exact new file path in task.new_paths as well as allowed_paths. Use official primary sources only; preserve source URLs, stable evidence locators, plan/version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, source precision, and deferred depth. Candidate decisions must remain needs_review or not_assessable, human_review.status must remain pending, publication.eligible must remain false, and no reviewed_complete promotion is allowed. Never infer unpublished facts, reuse historical actuals as current without official linkage, collapse fiscal/document/year states, promote drafts, create policy-achievement scores, infer causality, or create unverified comparisons/rankings. Run repository validation and relevant regression tests before PR. Success is a green bounded PR containing a complete Akita non-public candidate while Morioka remains awaiting human review and the canonical queue remains unchanged.

acceptance: Candidate remains non-public with human review pending and publication ineligible.
Official-source evidence, period/version/fiscal boundaries, and deferred depth remain explicit.
Relevant repository validation and regression tests remain green.
tasks.outcome: Create or complete the municipality's non-public Phase 15 review candidate and deterministic candidate regression coverage while preserving the repository's human-review boundary.
